name: Zenith Echo 5G
description: Zenith Echo 5G is an AI productivity smartphone built for young professionals and university students, featuring contextual AI lecture summaries, dual-mic noise cancelled interview recording, smart day-planner routines, and an extended battery life with 67W flash charging.
target_group: University students and early-career working professionals

features.name: Contextual AI Audio Summaries
features.explanation: Automatically transcribes, timestamps, and summarizes lectures, interviews, and meetings locally.

features.name: Smart Adaptive Power
features.explanation: Machine learning routine that learns commute and study hours to deliver up to 36 hours of battery.

features.name: Low-Light Studio Portrait 2.0
features.explanation: Automated exposure and depth enhancement for crisp, vibrant photos in dim indoor lighting.

features.name: On-Device Privacy Vault
features.explanation: Isolated sandbox separating personal documents and AI processing from cloud tracking.

features.name: 120Hz Fluid AMOLED Display
features.explanation: Smooth high-refresh display optimized for rapid multitasking and split-screen reading.

features.name: ZenOS Distraction-Free UI
features.explanation: Minimalist, bloat-free user interface with intelligent study focus modes and zero adware.
